tasks.title: Add deterministic race-domain tests
acceptance: Extract lap/checkpoint ranking logic into testable GDScript domain code

tasks.blocker: The repository does not include a mechanism to run Godot scripts in a headless test environment, nor does it provide a GDScript testing framework. Consequently, it is impossible to write and validate deterministic race-domain tests that execute the extracted logic without additional tooling or CI changes.
